::: notes
Allow about 50 minutes. Follow the current program: second derivatives come before the first-derivative test and concavity. Use the current booklet numbering, Examples 1.5–1.8, rather than the old PowerPoint's 1.16–1.19. The cover is schematic, not a set of graphs to read numerically. Worked solutions are in notes for delivery in OneNote.
:::
